input.title: Input
input.description: The number exactly as you supplied it.

type.title: Type
type.description: ABN or ACN, or null if the length was wrong.

valid.title: Check digit OK
valid.description: True when the check digit matches. Does not prove the business is registered.

formatted.title: Formatted
formatted.description: The number in the standard grouped format.

reason.title: Reason if not OK
reason.description: Why the number failed, or null.

possibleAcn.title: ACN inside the ABN
possibleAcn.description: For a valid ABN whose last 9 digits are a valid ACN. A hint only.
